newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Discount Bank chairman resigns.
newsitem.headline: Israel Discount Bank chairman resigns.

text.p: Israel Discount Bank chairman Gideon Lahav is resigning from his post after five years, the bank said on Monday.
Lahav, who has been with the bank for 18 years, said there was no particular reason for his leaving.
"No event caused this. I feel I have come to the end of the road. I am in good shape and the bank is in even better shape," he told Reuters. He added he had no "firm plans" for the future.
Before being becoming chairman, Lahav had been managing director of the bank for over five years.

A spokeswoman for the bank, Israel's third largest, said no date was set yet for Lahav's departure, but the bank noted in a statement that it would hold its annual general meeting on June 24 to elect new directors.
